title: Thor and his hammer.
lines: High above the clouds there is a golden land.
Thor has long blond hair and a red cape.
And he has a very special hammer.
When Thor swings his hammer, lightning flashes.
But Thor is a bit of a show-off.
He doesn't listen to others very well.
Odin says: Thor, a real hero isn't just strong.
A real hero is also kind and helps others.
He argues and he always wants to fight.
And he throws the hammer down too.
Only someone who is good and kind can lift this hammer, says Odin.
Thor falls to Earth, in a desert.
She gives Thor food and a place to sleep.
Thor learns a lot on Earth.
He learns to say thank you.
He finds his hammer in the desert.
Then a big metal giant comes to the village.
But he walks up to the giant anyway.
Leave the people alone, he says.
Thor doesn't want to be the strongest anymore.
He only wants to protect the others.
At that moment the hammer starts to shake.
Now you're a real hero, says Odin.
But he never forgets his friends on Earth.
